name: 01570 · Webster, MA
findings: ZIP 01570 (Webster) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01570 (Webster) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
